resources.string: Updates this tablet\'s display services from the copy inside this installer, installs the pinned DisplayXR stack, and performs the post-install steps that an APK install does not do. Reboot when it finishes.
What this installer does NOT do

• Each package is confirmed by Android separately. One tap here is still N confirmations — only a device owner or a privileged system app can install silently, and this is neither. The two display services appear as "an update to this built-in application"; that is expected.

• It cannot reboot the tablet. When the display services changed you MUST restart it yourself — skipping that can leave the glass flat 2D while every app reports 3D.

• It cannot grant CAMERA to Gaussian Splat or Avatar. Accept the prompt on their first launch, otherwise they open on a consent dialog instead of content.

• After a reboot, UNLOCK the tablet before opening any app. Launching a demo at the lockscreen crashes Model Viewer and Gaussian Splat (displayxr-runtime#1358).

• If an app was installed from a build signed with a different key, Android refuses the upgrade. This installer reports that rather than wiping the app’s data behind your back; uninstall that one app and run again.
